verdict.rationale: Mintlify's agent researches, plans, and writes docs, then opens pull requests for team review. It can be triggered from a prompt in the editor or from Slack, which also opens a PR. Automations run it on a schedule, on repository pushes, or on integration events, and the editor agent can leave comments and suggestions. Missing for 10: an explicit PR-event trigger (only repository pushes are documented), a dedicated agent review of incoming changes beyond editor comments and suggestions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
